LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.label: cavalry sabre
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.description: A curved single-edged blade with a steel basket guard. It cuts fast and keeps the hand safe.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.tools.0.label: guard
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Sabre.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.label: flintlock musket
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.description: A long smoothbore flintlock. Slow to reload and wild at range, but a heavy lead ball stops anything it hits.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Musket.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.label: rifled musket
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.description: A muzzle-loading rifle with a socket bayonet. It hits a man at three hundred paces and still fights when the powder runs out.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Rifle.tools.1.label: bayonet
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Blunderbuss.label: blunderbuss
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Blunderbuss.description: A short gun with a flared brass mouth, loaded with a handful of shot. Useless across a field, terrible across a room. Coachmen and ship's crews swear by it.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Blunderbuss.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Blunderbuss.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FlintlockPistol.label: flintlock pistol
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FlintlockPistol.description: A holster pistol with a brass butt cap: one shot, then a club. Officers carry a pair of them.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FlintlockPistol.tools.0.label: grip
LanguageData.HE_Albion_FlintlockPistol.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Breechloader.label: breech-loading rifle
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Breechloader.description: A falling-block rifle: pull the lever, drop in a cartridge, close it and fire. A trained man fires ten aimed rounds a minute.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Breechloader.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Albion_Breechloader.tools.1.label: bayonet
LanguageData.HE_Albion_LightMG.label: Albion light machine gun
LanguageData.HE_Albion_LightMG.description: A pan-fed light machine gun with a cooling jacket round the barrel and a bipod folded under it. Heavy and slow to bring up, it puts six rounds where one would go. The works of Albion make it with more steel and fewer fine parts than most such guns.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_LightMG.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Albion_LightMG.tools.1.label: barrel
